# findReplaceAllTextInSlide

<link-summary>Replaces every occurrence of a text on one slide.</link-summary>

<web-summary>findReplaceAllTextInSlide() — Replaces every occurrence of a text on one slide. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/slide</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function findReplaceAllTextInSlide(
  slide: GoogleAppsScript.Slides.Slide,
  findText: string,
  replaceText: string,
  matchCase: boolean = true
): number;
```

Slides offers find-and-replace across a whole presentation; this narrows it to a single slide, which is what filling one templated page at a time needs. Matching is case-sensitive unless told otherwise.

## Parameters

| Parameter                         | Type                            | Description                                              |
| :-------------------------------- | :------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------- |
| `slide`                           | `GoogleAppsScript.Slides.Slide` | The slide to work on.                                    |
| `findText`                        | `string`                        | The text to look for.                                    |
| `replaceText`                     | `string`                        | The text to put in its place.                            |
| `matchCase` _(optional)_ `= true` | `boolean`                       | Whether the search is case-sensitive. `true` by default. |

## Returns

`number` — how many occurrences were replaced.

## Throws

| Exception                | Condition                          |
| :----------------------- | :--------------------------------- |
| `SlideNotFoundException` | the first argument is not a slide. |

## Examples

### In use

```javascript
const slide = SlidesApp.getActivePresentation().getSlides()[0];

const replaced = findReplaceAllTextInSlide(slide, "{{ client }}", "Acme", false);
```
